# Test fixtures

`example.hwp` — a legacy HWP5 sample whose own text declares its terms:
"License: Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported. Feel free to use and share the
file according to the license above." (CC-BY-SA 3.0). It came from
`https://github.com/jongwony/python_hwp/blob/master/example.hwp` (the file was
produced by online-convert.com; the placeholder text is the Wikipedia "John
Doe" article). It is used only as parser input in the tests; no code from that
repository is used or copied.
